title: Build the team
summary: From one hire to a team: the ATS and hiring pipeline stood up, benefits enrolled, the handbook published, the review cycle running, the option grants approved and recorded.

parts.title: Set up ATS
parts.guidance: Configure recruiting around the open roles, interview stages and hiring owners. Make candidate history, correspondence and evaluations accessible to the relevant hiring team, with sensitive material restricted appropriately. Walk one representative application through intake and stage handoffs to catch missing owners or lost correspondence before the recruiting team relies on the system.

parts.title: Build a hiring pipeline
parts.guidance: Build a repeatable hiring pipeline from the agreed role requirements and interview plan. Align sourcing, screening, assessment and decision criteria before outreach begins. Use the hiring workflow to track evidence and candidate communication, with hiring-manager approval at the offer stage; keep sourced contacts, active applicants and offers in their respective pipeline stages.

parts.title: Set up benefits
parts.guidance: Gather the workforce locations, employment arrangements, budget and current coverage before comparing benefits. Use the benefits workflow to confirm eligibility, employer choices and enrollment responsibilities with the relevant advisers and providers. Record the selected plans, effective coverage and enrollment status, including any employee actions still needed to activate benefits.

parts.title: Write the employee handbook
parts.guidance: Draft the handbook from the company's actual policies and working arrangements, including who can answer questions or authorize exceptions. Use the handbook workflow to obtain jurisdiction-specific review and management approval before distribution. Publish the approved version, record employee acknowledgment where required by the chosen process, and keep a clear route for future policy updates.

parts.title: Run performance reviews
parts.guidance: Define the review period, participants and evaluation criteria before collecting feedback. Run the performance-review workflow with evidence tied to role expectations and a clear manager handoff for the conversation. Complete the manager conversation and record the agreed development actions, performance decisions and follow-up dates privately.

parts.title: Issue stock options
parts.guidance: Prepare proposed option grants from the approved hiring or compensation decisions, the current equity plan and reconciled ownership records. Follow the grant workflow for valuation, legal review, corporate authorization and recipient documentation. Return the approved and completed grant records to the cap table, distinguishing a compensation proposal from an option that has actually been issued.
